01 / About

Vinoth is a results-driven Data Analyst with 4.5+ years of experience turning raw operational data into decisions — spanning sales, inventory, shipment, and replenishment across retail supply chains.

His work sits at the intersection of SQL, Python, and Power BI: building forecasting models, designing exception reports, and shipping dashboards that planning and merchandising teams actually use day to day. He's equally comfortable deep in a data migration — profiling, validating, and reconciling legacy systems — as he is presenting a finished KPI view to stakeholders.
